root_cause: In agentic_rl_learner.py:3309, when p28_g6_update is not active (standard unsegmented learner), the post-update check inspects self.rl_cluster.global_steps (which is only incremented at the bottom of the loop, thus 0) instead of actor_trainer.train_steps (which was already incremented to 1 by update_actor). This causes the assertion enclosing_global_step == policy_step + 1 (0 == 0 + 1) to fail.
error_message: P57 evaluation cycle mapping drifted: policy_step=0 enclosing_global_step=0
fix_required: In agentic_rl_learner.py line 3309, inspect getattr(self.rl_cluster.actor_trainer, 'train_steps', self.rl_cluster.global_steps) when not p28_g6_update.
